mapper.insert: insert into calendar (calendar_id, calendar_title, calendar_description, calendar_start_date, calendar_end_date,calendar_status,calendar_photo) values (#{calendarId}, #{calendarTitle}, #{calendarDescription}, #{calendarStartDate}, #{calendarEndDate},#{calendarStatus},#{calendarPhoto} )
mapper.update: update calendar set calendar_title = #{calendarTitle}, calendar_description = #{calendarDescription}, calendar_start_date = #{calendarStartDate}, calendar_end_date = #{calendarEndDate}, calendar_status = #{calendarStatus}, calendar_photo = #{calendarPhoto} where calendar_id = #{calendarId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calendar WHERE calendar_start_date <= #{endDate} AND calendar_end_date >= #{startDate} AND calendar_status = TRUE
SELECT * FROM calendar ORDER BY calendar_id ASC
